D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Derek Tran leads by 24.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 61,988 votes; a one point swing is about 1,269 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +16.7 and D +32.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$3.3M cash against $75K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
